solar-array.name: Solar Array
solar-array.description: Fixed panel farm. Recharges the rover quickly within 4 tiles (daylight only).

beacon.name: Nav Beacon
beacon.description: Marks a site on the map and lights the area at night.

drill-rig.name: Auto-Drill Rig
drill-rig.description: Slowly mines the column beneath it. Drive adjacent to collect its buffer.

cache.name: Supply Cache
cache.description: Deposit cargo here to bank it as mission yield and free up the hold.

refinery.name: Refinery
refinery.description: Furnace module. Unlocks alloy smelting when the rover is parked beside it.

habitat-frame.name: Habitat Frame
habitat-frame.description: The first bones of a permanent outpost, raised from refined materials.

habitat.name: Habitat
habitat.description: A finished pressurised outpost. Recharges and slowly repairs a rover parked alongside it.

launch-pad.name: Launch Pad
launch-pad.description: Fuelled gantry. Park beside it and fire the hold home — or let it auto-ship a neighbouring drill line. Refuels between launches.

generator.name: Generator
generator.description: Radioisotope plant. Powers nearby structures day and night — the backbone of an outpost grid.

pylon.name: Power Pylon
pylon.description: Relays power onward, extending the grid to distant drills and pads.

recipes.name: Iron plate
recipes.description: Press raw iron into structural stock for advanced construction.

recipes.name: Water
recipes.description: Melt and filter surface ice. Valuable cargo everywhere.

recipes.name: Ti-alloy
recipes.description: Furnace-grade titanium alloy. Requires an adjacent refinery.
